When the team is visited by a rabid pack of sponsors who want to sign them to product contracts, Grandpa is forced to step in and recommend that Tyson have a talk with his more experienced brother, Hiro. While looking for Hiro, Tyson and friends come across Tala, Bryan and Spencer, who are on their way to get revenge on Boris by bringing the BEGA league down around him. Tyson is torn between following Tala, and respecting Tala's wish that he stay out of it.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: An intense battle is played out on the stadium floor, when, it looks like Tala is about to lose, bars rise up out of the floor and keep him in the dish. As they continue to battle, Tala becomes weaker and weaker and collapses. Tyson's had enough. He yells out at Boris telling him his whole BEGA outfit is bogus and he challenges the shadowy figure to a battle. Boris accepts the challenges and at stake is the future of the BEGA and Tyson's future as a Beyblader!! Most of Tyson's friends surround him in a show of support, except one. Kai walks out of the stands and walks right by Tyson leaving him high and dry!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In response to Tyson's challenge of a one on one battle against the best Blader in BEGA, Boris counters by suggesting a five on five match. Tyson wants to accept but the odds are stacked against him. Kai has now joined the BEGA Blader's and BEGA now virtually controls the whole sport because they have set up an I.D. registration service for all Blader's who want to become professionals. Worst of all, Hiro, Tyson's brother has been hired on to coach the BEGA Blader's! Tyson tells his troubles to Ray but gets no sympathy. Secretly Ray has always wanted to battle Tyson when he was at his championship best so he challenges his old friend. An intense battle ensues with Tyson eventually coming out the winner. Ray is satisfied but his blade and Tyson's is ruined. With no hope of getting replacement parts the team decides to build their own blades and go face the BEGA Blader's in battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Hiro stuns the world by joining the BEGA League and coaching Brooklyn, their secret weapon. As the popularity of the new league rises, BBA Revolution find themselves unable to practice because Boris has cornered the market on new parts. Boris is satisfied with the progress of his top Blader's, who are training heavily in a series of practice and exhibition matches. Ming Ming and the rest of her teammates easily dispatch the competition.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and Daichi disguise themselves in an effort to get badly needed replacement parts for their damaged Beyblades. But without an official BEGA I.D. card signifying membership in the new league ' something they steadfastly refuse to get - they're shut out from getting parts at any store. Despairing about how they'll solve this dilemma, they're visited by members of various teams they fought against in the World Championships: White Tiger X, PPB All Starz, Barthez Battalion, and F Dynasty. These former foes don't like Boris and his professional BEGA league either, seeing this new entity as a threat to the sport of Beyblading. They vow to help Tyson and the other members of the BBA Revolution in whatever way they can to overthrow BEGA.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The good news is, the Hard Metal Beyblades are ready to go'the bad news: no one knows how to control them! Tyson, Daichi, Ray and Max each spend the day trying to learn the delicate new intricacies of the Hard Metal Beyblade, but the new blades seem to get the better of our heroes over and over again'some even wind up headfirst in the lake'No real progress is being made'It isn't until the gang remembers what it was like when they first started Beyblading, including all the roadblocks that they once came across, that they realize the secret of reining in their new spinners'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson, Max and Ray struggle to learn the 'Hard Metal' system with the help of some of their friends from the World Championship tournament. They still need one more member for the team, and Rick, Lee and Michael have all volunteered to fill the remaining slot. But first they have to prove they can master the new system'which proves a lot tougher than they thought.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bega Bladers have one more Blader to pick for the BEGA 5 Justice Tournament and it's between the up and coming Brooklyn and Kai. As their elimination battle begins, Kai tries his best to take command but it seems Brooklyn mirrors his every move. Kai realizes something's fishy, but before he can do anything about it, Brooklyn takes the win, much to Boris's liking.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the start of 'Justice 5' and Daichi is set to battle Ming Ming, the crowd favorite because of her cute demeanor and sensational singing voice. Daichi's goal is to prove that Ming Ming doesn't take Beyblading seriously and he vows to knock her out of the stadium early in the match. However, when Ming Ming gains the upper hand this makes Daichi very annoyed. Worst of all, Ming Ming has the nerve to break into song as if to mock Daichi. Even worse, her singing seems to make her Blading improve and she slams Strata Dragoon relentlessly. Kenny, a devoted fan of Ming Ming's, realizes that it's her voice that helps her concentrate on her blade and Tyson tells Daichi of her secret. Daichi uses his own voice to unleash the full power of Strata Dragoon but in the end Ming Ming proves to be the better blader and wins the match. Daichi is disappointed but being a good sportsman he congratulates Ming Ming. Tyson and the others realize that the Bega Bladers intend to fight fairly and they all vow to do their very best to win the next battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the second match of the Justice Five Battle and Ray and Crusher are facing off against each other. With Ming Ming's win against Daichi in the previous match, the BEGA League is already ahead by one so the pressure is on Ray to take the match. But Crusher is feeling the pressure too, not only for himself and his teammates but for his sister, Monica, who is undergoing surgery at the very same time. From the beginning, the battle is fierce with both Blader's inflicting significant damage. But Ray quickly gains the upper hand and it looks like its game over. It is only once Crusher calls upon the spirit of his brave, little sister that he is filled with the courage and strength necessary to match Ray. But with so much at stake, which Blader will emerge victorious?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first two matches of the 'Justice 5' tournament are complete, and things aren't looking good for Tyson's squad, G Revolutions. BEGA's team is up two games to one in the best-of-five series. If they lose another match, BEGA will be victorious and have complete control over the sport of Beyblading. This puts a lot of pressure on Max to win game three against Mystel. Tyson and the others argue whether Max's signature defensive style will be enough to overcome Mystel's unpredictable and overpowering attack. Max takes this as a sign that his teammates only think he can win if he changes the way he Beyblades altogether. His confidence shattered, Max isolates himself and does some soul-searching. He receives a morale boost from a unlikely source ' Rick, his contentious PPB All Starz partner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: With three rounds already played, the G Revolutions team finds themselves with an unimpressive record' two matches lost, and one ending in a draw. Tyson and the rest of the team are practicing furiously to guarantee a check in the win column for tomorrow's big match. The bad news is, no one on the team has the same skill with the Hard Metal Beyblade as Tyson does' or at least that's what he thinks, and he refuses to choose any of his teammates to Blade in the last round of the tournament, insisting instead to blade both rounds himself. As all of the others vie for the last spot, Kai's frustration at his lack of control with his new Hard Metal Beyblade reaches an all-time high, combine that with his anger at what happened to Tala, and Kai's mood is even less cheery than usual. It isn't until he connects with an unlikely Blading opponent that he gains the technique he's been seeking for so long'the real question is, will Tyson and the rest of the gang welcome Kai back after all they've been through in the past?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the continuation of the Justice 5 Tournament with the BEGA Blader's leading the battle with two wins and a tie. If G Revolutions lose the next battle, they're out and BEGA (lead by the evil Boris) takes over the Beyblading Empire. The next battle is set to pit Tyson against Garland, but when the G Revolutions enter the stadium, they reveal their fifth team member- KAI!! Everyone is stunned, except for the BEGA Blader's who see him only as a loser. Kai is out for revenge because a few days earlier he lost a battle to Brooklyn. So, wanting to save face, Kai calls out Brooklyn, who arrogantly accepts his challenge. A massive battle ensues with Kai trying desperately to somehow attack his opponent, but nothing seems to work. And what's worse, Brooklyn seems to be copying Kai's every move. Kai becomes frustrated and realizes he must dig deep within himself to draw out more power. He does, however, it's making him weaker and weaker. The rest of the G Revolutions team wants him to quit. Kai refuses and in the end, he prepares for a final assault against his foe!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The battle of 'Justice 5 Tournament' continues and Kai is clearly overwhelmed by the power of Brooklyn of the Bega Bladers. Attack after attack sees Kai barely hanging on as he fights to stay in the match. Tyson and his team mates nervously watch, but vow to stay out of the battle because of a promise that Tyson made to Kai. Pleased with the progress of the battle and confident that Brooklyn will win, Boris watches from the sidelines with delight. Kai's determination to win against these unbeatable odds begins to frustrate Brooklyn and he increases the intensity of his attacks. Suddenly, when it seems that Kai can't take any more he manages to draw upon his Beyblading spirit and defeat Brooklyn. The crowd goes wild at this dramatic upset and Kai leaves the stadium only to collapse into Tyson's arms, battered and bruised. Brooklyn remains in the stadium, stunned and confused after suffering the first defeat of his Beyblading career. Kai assures his concerned team mates that he's all right and tells Tyson that he should be more concerned with his upcoming battle against Garland. Tyson, as confident as ever, shrugs Kai's advice off but secretly hopes he can summon the same amazing strength that his old friend showed in his battle. Kai walks unsteadily out of the stadium alone, collapses again, and then watches as Dranzer disintegrates in front of him.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: All of G Revolutions hopes now rest on Tyson's match with Garland. Tyson is determined to make sure Kai's brave victory over Brooklyn isn't wasted. Garland is confident he will win. His family have been sports champions for centuries thanks to a book containing the Tzebult Principles of Victory. Those who follow the principles never lose! Tyson seeks the help of his friends to prepare, finding comfort and focus in their company. The match begins and Garland seems unbeatable due to the family principles. But Tyson isn't satisfied' he wants to fight the real Garland, not a book of rules. Tyson convinces Garland to abandon the family code and Beybattle like a true Blader. But can he withstand the full force of Garland unleashed?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Brooklyn has gone a little loopy after his loss against Kai. And the loss means either BEGA or the G Revolutions need one more victory to win the Justice 5 Tournament. To determine a winner, one battle is left and it will pit Tyson going up against one of the BEGA Blader's. But who will it be? Garland offers his services, but Hiro turns him down cold saying they need Brooklyn to fight this battle. Brooklyn's on the brink of a breakdown and now it's up to Hiro to get him back into fighting form.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match between the G Revolutions and the BEGA Bladers has arrived. Tyson prepares for the contest, unsure of whom he will ultimately face. It isn't until he steps onto the stadium floor when he discovers that he will go face to face, against Brooklyn himself. Brooklyn shows off his incredible powers immediately, stunning both teams on either side of the Beystadium. But no one has any idea of the true extent of Brooklyn's powers until he creates a wormhole to another dimension, creating an empty shell, carbon copy of the real world! The freak out continues as Brooklyn destroys everything in his new empty world to mold it into an image that makes him happy! Tyson has never faced an opponent like this! Does he stand a chance, or will BEGA continue its evil infection of the Beyblading community?

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's mid-way through Tyson and Brooklyn's final tie-breaking 'Justice 5' match which could give BEGA a stranglehold on the entire sport of Beyblading. Having suffered his only previous defeat at the hands of Kai, Brooklyn's thirst for revenge takes the form of an unearthly power. Not only has his Beyblade Zeus given Brooklyn sinister black wings with which to fly, it's generated a giant vortex in the sky that is wreaking havoc on the city. Buildings are crumbling everywhere. The entire world is being enveloped by the growing darkness. Only Tyson can stop Brooklyn before it's too late. Summoning his own formidable power from Dragoon, Tyson flies into the sky to convince Brooklyn to cease the negative emotions that are causing the havoc. When reasoning fails, the pair continues their battle above the ever-crumbling city. The tide turns in Tyson's favor when he's able to summon the spirits of his teammates' blades and merge them with Dragoon, which evolves into the most powerful Beyblade ever. By probing deeper into Brooklyn's psyche, Tyson learns that his foe's anxiety stems from childhood isolation at being a genius so early in life. Tyson makes Brooklyn see that Beyblading is a pure sport to be enjoyed for one reason alone ' the love of the game. Brooklyn calms down. The chaos ends. And the pair continues their match simply for enjoyment. With BEGA's HQ in shambles, the upstart league and its owner Boris are ruined. Mr. Dickenson's BBA league restarts, but in a much more modest form. And kids everywhere ' including Tyson and his friends - return to the simple, purest form of Beyblading.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson is at home practicing martial arts with his grandfather when suddenly he realizes he's late for a Beyblade battle with Andrew. As he runs out of his house he's confronted by a couple of bullies who only slow him up for his real battle. But when Tyson does show up, Andrew and his friends are met by a smart mouthed kid named Carlos who's a member of the notorious Blade Sharks. Carlos challenges anyone to a battle but the winner gets to keep the others Beyblades. Tyson accepts. With the help of Kenny and his Bit Beast Dizzi, who's trapped inside his laptop, Tyson prepares for the big battle, which he handily wins. But the just when the fight is over, the Blade Shark's leader Kai shows up and a new battle begins between Kai and Tyson

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson battles Kai one on one, but to his surprise, Tyson quickly loses. The Chief informs Tyson, that in order to beat Kai, you need a strategy, so Tyson goes home in an attempt to practice until he's perfected his fighting technique. Later that day, Andrew and Kenny, along with Dizzi show up and attempt to increase the power of Tyson's blade to match that of Kai, but with little success. Tyson is feeling glum about his chances of ever beating Kai, but suddenly, out of nowhere, the Bit Beast Dragoon appears and flies straight towards him and goes directly into Tyson's beyblade. Tyson is stunned after realizing Dragoon does exists and is now inside his beyblade. With renewed confidence, Tyson knows the time is right to challenge Kai once again to do battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: In a moment of heroism, Max, the new Beyblader in town, shows Tyson that with the proper skill and training, there is nothing that can't be achieved. The two soon become fast friends, leaving Kenny feeling left out.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Beyblade Regional Qualifying Tournament is underway as Tyson, Max, Ray and even Kenny are entered to see if they can dethrone Kai, the reigning champion. As our announcers, Brad Best and A.J. Topper rev up the crowd, Kenny is first into battle but without a Bit Beast in his blade, he falls quickly to Kai.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Max is completely overpowered in his semi-finals match against Kai. It's not until the Bit Beast known as Draciel emerges from Max's Grandmother's pendant, to add its power to Max's Beyblade that the tables begin to turn.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Qualifying Tournament is in its final stages as Tyson has advanced to face Ray in the semi-finals. As the best of three battles gets underway, Tyson's bravado quickly fades as Ray handily wins the first round when he destroys Tyson's Beyblade with his famous Tiger Claw Attack.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The National Beyblade Championship Match is set, with Tyson facing off against reigning champion, Kai. It's not until Grandpa throws a surprise party for Tyson, that the rookie sensation realizes he's forgotten his own Birthday!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tyson and his team prepare for the Hong Kong world championships. Kai seems to reject his newfound team and leads them on a chase through the streets. That's where the guys learn some lessons about Beyblading from some very mysterious 'bladers. After a decisive victory, Tyson and the gang discover that the alley bladders make up the membership of 'The White Tiger Team'' Whatever that is'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Our heroes arrive in Hong Kong on a stop-over to the Asian Beyblade Tournament when they run into Ray's old gang the White Tigers. A confrontation quickly ensues with no one coming out the clear winner.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The first round of the Asian Tournament sees the Bladebreakers facing off against the team called the Tall-Boys, with Ray's ex-teammates, The White Tigers, waiting in the wings.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The night before the Asian Tournament, Kevin decides to steal data from Kenny's laptop to get the edge for his White Tiger Team. Unfortunately, Kenny catches him red-handed which sets up a battle between Ray and Kevin, which ends in dire consequences for Ray.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After realizing his Bit Beast is gone, Ray decides to head for the mountains in an attempt to get it back. Tyson and Mariah give chase and confront Ray to decide which team he wants to be on.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The White Tiger Team faces off against the Spin-Shepards in the quarterfinals of the Asian Tournament. When Ray sees that Lee is also using the 'Tiger Claw' attack, he is forced to finally open up to his teammates about his mysterious past.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the morning of the semi-finals at the Asian Beyblade Tournament and Tyson manages to sleep in. The rest of the team leaves early, but Ray stays behind to make sure Tyson wakes up. As the tournament gets underway, Max is the first to battle. Meanwhile, Ray and Tyson are caught up in a traffic jam created by a landslide, so they decide to walk. But the shortest route is over a mountain where Ray sprains his ankle and Tyson is left to carrying him all the way to there.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The finals are about to begin in the Asian Qualifying Tournament with the winning team advancing to the World Beyblading Championships. In the first round, Max goes against Gary from the White Tigers in a best of three battle. The first round goes without a hitch as Max easily takes care of his opponent and with the win, Max becomes a little over confident.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: During the finals of the Asian Tournament, Ray faces off against his old teammate, and former friend, Mariah. When Galux and Driger team up to show the pair a glimpse of the happiness they shared in the past, Ray and Mariah come to realize how much they have lost, by being rivals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The final match of the Asian Beyblade Tournament reaches an uncertain conclusion when Tyson and Lee's decisive battle ends in a draw. The resulting sudden death session between Ray and Lee rekindles the pair's old hometown grievances.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Fresh from the Bladebreakers win in Asia, Tyson comes home and realizes he's front page news! With his ego out of control, Tyson takes on the attitude of a rock star, which upsets Kenny who tries to keep him focused on blading and not his popularity. Meanwhile, at a local playground, the local kids are all out Beyblading when Tyson spots a kid (Nicky), being smoked in the Beystadium by a bully (Riley). After Nicky's blade is completely destroyed, Tyson vows to help the kid fix it and fight his way back.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in the USA for the American Tournament. During a tour of a BBA research facility, Max is shocked to learn that his Mom works there, and not at the college, like he thought. To make matters worse, the team discovers that they are being tested for weaknesses, by a competing team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their non-competition loss to Emily of the All Starz at the BBA Research Center, the Blade Breakers sneak around the high-tech facility, hoping to learn more about their competition. There, they confront two other All Starz, and Max learns more about his Mom's job at the BBA - specifically, a rumor of why Max wasn't asked to join the All Starz Team.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: For some strange reason, Mr. Dickenson has sent the Blade Breakers to a remote mountain retreat to hone their blading skills for the upcoming American Tournament as well as to get Kenny and Dizzi to figure out a way to increase Ray's Bit Beast's power. Once there, they meet up with a enthusiastic young boy named Antonio who they think is there to train them. Turns out, Antonio is a pathetic blader.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: A charity event in the Heartland of America gives the Bladebreakers a taste of the All Starz' prowess. Featuring celebrities in a three-on-three contest against young Beybladers of note, Emily of the All Starz, bullies her way to an easy win. It isn't until Emily knocks out her own opponent, loses the second match and is on her way to throwing the whole competition, that Max teaches her what teamwork is all about.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers arrive in Las Vegas for the start of the American Tournament. Tyson looks forward to facing off against the arrogant All-Starz, and their scientifically advanced Beyblades'but first his team needs to get past the 'Renegades' in the qualifying round. Kai surprises everyone by stepping into the dish for the first battle!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Blade Breakers have advanced to the second round of the American Tournament where they square off against the Savage Slammers. The winner of this round advances to the semi-finals. Their competition first appears to be a bunch of slackers, but when Ray loses out in the first round, they quickly realize what they're up against. Max is next, and for some odd reason, his rival folds under pressure, so the best of three is tied at one a piece with Tyson coming in for the deciding battle.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the Bladebreakers versus Spintensity in the semi-finals of the American Tournament. But before the match can begin, Tyson is forced to withdraw with a stomachache he got from too much celebratory eating. Max, Ray and Kai must drag race their crafty foes through the whirlwind, highway-themed dish called the New Jersey Turnpike.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Tensions rise as the American Tournament heats up. Max fights for a chance to beyblade against his mother's team the All-Starz in an upcoming match, while Tyson and the rest of the Bladebreakers realize that the All-Starz are a bigger threat then they previously thought. At the end of two tense rounds, Tyson and Steven are tied one-all'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: It's the finals of the American Tournament and the Bladebreakers are going head to head with the All Starz with the winner going to the World Championships. In the first round, Tyson is pitted against Steve and at first things don't appear to be going Tyson's way. But with sheer determination, Tyson pulls out a victory that puts the Bladebreakers ahead one to nothing in the best of three finals.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The deciding match of the American Tournament Finals comes down to Max vs. Michael of the 'All Starz,' in a battle that pits science and technology against human spirit. Unfortunately for Max and the Bladebreakers, the trick dish turns out to be a replica of a baseball diamond'where Michael feels right at home!

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After narrowly defeating the All Starz at the American Tournament, Kenny decides he should record a database of the highs and low points of the BladeBreakers since the very beginning. In fact, through a series of flashbacks, the Chief along with Dizzi, takes a trip down memory lane as far back to the first time he ever met Tyson. With clips from various shows, Kenny narrates the progress of his friends who eventually form the BladeBreakers and go on to the Asian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: Traveling by boat across the Atlantic, the Bladebreakers must not only deal with Kenny's seasickness, but a gut-wrenching revelation. Tyson's on-board defeat at the hands of a mysterious foe - one wielding a Bit-Beast larger and stronger than any they've ever seen - exposes the team's vulnerability going into the Russian Tournament.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The kids are tricked into missing their boat, forcing them to spend the night in London where a mysterious videotape of Tyson's father is delivered to them. Later, Tyson's Beyblade is stolen and the kids are lured into a fight with the evil Cenotaph and his powerful Bit Beast, Sarcopholon. All seems lost until Kai defeats the mummy by using his own strengths against him. The team agrees to travel by land, learning from every European Beyblader they can find.

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: After their train is mysteriously hijacked, the kids find themselves in the dark recesses of a tunnel. This is where the Bladebreakers meet the members of the Dark Bladers! Soon the team is forced into a beyblade match to rescue Kenny from the monsters' evil clutches! But Kenny isn't the only prize in this dark match-up. For if the Bladebreakers lose, their bit-beasts are up for grabs'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: As the BladeBreakers make their way to the World Championships in Russia, they are stuck in Paris where they end up wasting a day looking for Kai who had mysteriously disappeared. Tyson comes up with the idea of using the Eiffel Tower as a vantage point to speed up their search. Ray, Kenny, Tyson and Max make their way to the observation deck of the tower where they are confronted by the Dark Bladers, a foursome of zombie-like ghouls who have vowed to steal the Bladebreakers Bit Beasts as part of their ultimate plan to capture all Bit Beasts in the world. A massive battle ensues but the odds are against our heroes. Finally, Kai shows up with his newly modified Dranzer and almost single-handedly wins the battle. The Dark Bladers fade away after their humiliating loss and just when you'd think it's over, a mysterious kid named Oliver shows up'

programme.title: Beyblade Classic
programme.desc: The Bladebreakers spend an extra day in Paris and split up to see the sights. Ray catches up with his uncle, Max goes on a wild shopping spree and Kai goes in search of information. Tyson and Kenny try to see the Louvre but end up Beyblading Oliver, the French Champion. At first Oliver's Bit Beast, Unicolyon, is too much for Dragoon. But Tyson soon proves that even the French Champion has a thing or two to learn about Beyblading.

programme.title: Magic Kaito 1412 [English Dub]
programme.desc: In this final episode, Kid goes up against the enigmatic Corbeau one more time as they vie for the jewel that may contain Pandora, which means Snake can't be far behind!

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Sadohara thinks that by making the Ishiyama students do their own physical examinations that they're sure to cause trouble, which would be enough to get them all expelled! But when Furuichi and Oga end up hiding under a desk while the girls get changed, they've got trouble of a whole other kind...

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Raising Baby Beel isn't getting any easier, and Oga is determined once again to find someone to dump him off on. Oga thinks maybe it takes more than brawn to attract Baby Beel, and starts to search for someone with brains, too! At the same time, rumors of a secret school group made of elite athletes whose job it is to enforce the school's moral code start going around, and members of Ishiyama's special class stop showing up to school... Who exactly are these 6 Holy Knights?

programme.title: Beelzebub [English Dub]
programme.desc: Oga and Furuichi go off in search of the rest of the 6 Holy Nights, but meanwhile Shiroyama is being picked on by some of St. Ishiyama's students, who know he can't fight back or risk getting expelled. It doesn't take long for the 6 Holy Knights to call out all of Ishiyama to the roof for a real showdown!

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: After shaking off Inspector Zenigata's pursuit, Lupin is stopped by a monstrously huge Fujiko on his way home! The giant Fujiko turns out to be an illusion created by Madame X. Lupin learns Madame X's hobby is collecting famous people.

programme.title: LUPIN THE 3rd PART 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Bandit leader Basara is determined to sniff out the location of the diamonds Lupin has hidden somewhere in India. Armed with his sinister invention, the Suicide Ray Gun, he tries to make Lupin talk, even trying his luck with a fake Fujiko.

programme.desc: When the battle ends, the one known as Father meets his final fate beyond the Gateway. When the one known as Fullmetal enters the sacred space, he finds only the promise of a new beginning.

programme.desc: Paco demanda a su expareja por plagio, alega que le robó una aplicación para encuentros de tríos. Bruno exige que su esposa Helena desaloje a su familia y a su ex, que los trajo sin avisarle.

programme.title: Caso Cerrado
programme.desc: Miembros de la iglesia católica debatirán los asuntos actuales que han surgido en los medios desde la controversia del Padre Alberto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: El trabajo de Juan es calentar a los actores porno antes de grabar; su esposa quiere el divorcio. Andrés descubre que su hija es fruto de una infidelidad; quiere dejar a su esposa y a la niña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yudi abandona a su familia para ganar una competencia, su esposo le exige que se ocupe del niño. Loreta demanda a su esposa porque quiere someterse a un suicidio asistido e involucra a su hijo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Julio quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hijo, la madre usa al niño para recaudar dinero en internet. Pablo e Iñaki contratan a una madre subrogada, ahora se divorcian y no saben qué hacer.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Yenni exige la aprobación de su esposo para dar en adopción a su hija que tiene una grave malformación. Pedro demanda a su empleadora, quien lo incitó a masturbarse ante la cámara y luego lo despidió.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Marlene aprueba que los maestros porten armas, su esposo no, ella quiere el divorcio y la custodia de su hija. Sasha pide la emancipación de sus gemelas, alega que ya no puede controlarlas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Melissa es pintora y tiene nueve años, afirma que su padre la explota, quiere vivir con su abuela. Ana pide que sus cuñados se ocupen de su suegra, perdió la razón y ella no puede cuidarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana se casó con Juan, su suegro, para obtener la residencia. Además, una bebé murió ahogada por su hermana mayor. La madre culpa al padre porque, mientras ocurría la tragedia, el hombre estaba teniendo sexo con la niñera que debía cuidar a las niñas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ana Lola es dueña de un asilo de ancianos donde los residentes tienen sexo unos con otros. Beba necesita un trasplante de médula ósea para sobrevivir, pero no quiere a su madre como donante.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: En casa de Yamileth inician un negocio ilegal de matar cerdos, teme que arresten a toda la familia. Laura es una mujer adulta con una extraña adicción: vivir como un bebé varias horas al día.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Ángela crea un tratamiento para rejuvenecer y el principal ingrediente es sangre de ratas; su arrendador la demanda. David demanda a su esposa; descubrió que los gemelos que adoptó tienen sida.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carla no soporta que su padre le fuera infiel a su madre, le exige que deje la casa y se divorcie. Nataly demanda a su hermana por acusarla falsamente de acoso sexual; quiere 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lucía demanda a su madre, asegura que malgasta su herencia en pagarle a su exnovio por su compañía. Liz descubre que su padre es gay y está enamorado de su hermano adoptivo, quiere desalojarlo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Andrés quiere la custodia de su hermanita de ocho años; su madre la sometió a una cirugía plástica. Carlos quiere cortarse el miembro; su esposa Fabiola exige que se someta a terapia psicológica.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: La esposa de Osmany quiere el divorcio, su cuñada, que reconozca a su hija y la mantenga, y su suegra, lanza una acusación. A Cintia le encanta el sexo oral, pero su esposo ya no puede más.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristian pide la custodia de su hijo, la mamá trata la diabetes del niño con saliva de reptil. José quiere desalojar a Valerie, estudiante venezolana de acogida, ella lo acusa de estafador.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Christian demanda al amante de su mujer, lo acusa de dañar su relación incitándolo a usar un roedor. Carlos pide ayuda para su esposa, descuida su embarazo por su hija mayor que está en coma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Cristal descubre que su esposo se viste de mujer y su medio hermano se lleva a su sobrina, ella lo acusa de no devolvérsela. Alexis pide ayuda para Cristopher, que está obsesionado con el fuego.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandra demanda al padre de sus hijos por darles alcohol, tabaco y drogas, él alega que solo los educa. Belén exige que su esposo desaloje a su amante, él se aprovechó de su depresión.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Damil demanda a la viuda de su fallecido hermano. Stacy la echó de la casa porque se enamoró de ella. Raquel está cansada de que Clemente, su novio, la obligue a disfrazarse para tener sexo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alejandra exige 100 mil dólares, su hija mató a su instructor por la negligencia del dueño del campo de tiro. Vivi pide desalojar a Cristopher, el amante de su marido, no lo quiere en su casa.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Annette exige el divorcio, su esposo está obsesionado con un batido que lo convirtió en infiel. Carolina pide la custodia de su sobrina, sus hermanos afirman que sus intenciones no son buenas.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tania demanda a Pamela por anular el contrato de vientre subrogado, pero la acusan de consumir droga. Jonathan exige que su exesposa lo indemnice por esconder sus bienes durante el divorcio.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Jorge le exige a su esposa Pamela que acepte a su bebé, ella rechaza al niño porque es negro. Luis pide la custodia de sus hijos, afirma que la mamá está incapacitada, el cáncer la dejó calva.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Nataly quiere anular su matrimonio con Claudia, ella la engañó y no le dio los papeles. A Javier lo deportan y pierde a sus hijos, regresa a buscarlos, pero su cuñado no quiere entregárselos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Adalberto exige la custodia de su hijo adolescente, lo acosan por ser gay y quiere suicidarse. Andrés acusa a su esposa de envenenar a la familia con la tecnología e intenta proteger a su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Lupita demanda a César, fueron pareja cuando él era sacerdote, pero dejó la iglesia y se enamoró de un hombre. John exige terapia psicológica para Lucía, le obsesiona el olor de sus senos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alfredo con 60 años se considera un tipo sexy y gracias a su bombita es infiel, su esposa pide el divorcio. La madre adoptiva de Julián lo maltrató por ser homosexual, ahora quiere desalojarla.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Claudia exige tratamiento psicológico para su marido, es adicto a darse placer a sí mismo en público y no tiene sexo con ella. Jin, cantante de hip-hop, demanda a su ex por vender videos sexuales de ambos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alicia pide terapia para su esposa Andrea, ella practica una extraña y peligrosa danza japonesa. Carlos quiere desalojar a Lázaro, él lo mandó a prisión y se quedó con su casa y con su hermana.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paula es adicta a la crema de mentol y la usa en todo su cuerpo, pero la crema le causó daño a su esposo y ahora él la demanda. Fabiola se convirtió al cristianismo y por eso le pide el divorcio a su pareja.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Por haberle transmitido sida, Sara le pide 500 mil dólares a Geovanny y la lista de las personas con las que ha tenido sexo. Claudia lo ataca con un machete, él la demanda por 50 mil dólares.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Viviana descubrió que su padre está muerto y no la abandonó como su madre dijo. También se dio cuenta de que esta ya se gastó toda la herencia que dejó el difunto.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Diana dice que su esposo cambió cuando la vio parir, ella cree que él es gay. Ahora pide la custodia de su hija y 25 mil dólares. Cynthia despide a César por fumar marihuana, él pide ser indemnizado.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Sebastián desea emanciparse de su mamá Andrea, quien vive con un sicario involucrado en el crimen de su padre. Carlos planea ir a Puerto Rico a vengar la muerte de su amigo, pero su esposa se opone.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Paulina averiguó que su esposo toma fotos de los hombres en los baños públicos, por lo que desea separarse. Danilo supo por Facebook que tiene un hijo y trata de detener el proceso para darlo en adopción.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Alonso pretende la custodia de una de las hijas mellizas de Antonio y Mariana. Sofía requiere que Michelle desaloje su casa porque se ha hecho adicta a olfatear los condones con semen.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Renata estaba embarazada de gemelos con un donante de esperma, pero uno de los bebés nació muerto y ahora se pelean por el otro. Rolando teme que su sobrina mate a su madre, por eso pide que se vaya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Maritza se entera de que su novia tuvo sexo con 364 hombres, por eso la demanda y cancela la boda. La mujer de Luis quiere el divorcio porque por culpa de él casi se electrocuta su hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Carlos pide una orden de alejamiento contra su esposa, quien mantiene una papa en la vagina. Juan solicita la custodia de su hijo porque su pareja es satanista y teme por su salud física y mental.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Karla quedó embarazada de su padrastro, al parir le dejó el bebé a su madre y ahora ella no se lo quiere devolver. Pilar le exige a Tania desalojar la casa que le alquiló antes de que la destruya.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Una niña de 14 años tiene la vagina deformada; insatisfecha, quiere autorización para operársela y lucir mejor. Una madre no deja que su hijo autista ayude a niños con cáncer; Ignacio la amenaza.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: En Portland, OR, un hombre no quiere que lo maltraten. En Hillsboro, OR, un hombre bajo custodia afirma haber sufrido una convulsión. En Cincinnati, OH, un hombre es detenido por robar aparatos de videojuegos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: En Fort Myers, FL, llevan a una mujer atada al centro de detención. En Portland, OR, un adolescente causando caos es detenido. En Las Vegas, NV, los del valet informan a las autoridades sobre una mujer saliendo manejando intoxicada.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Colocan a un hostil exmilitar en aislamiento. Oficiales detienen a un hombre por andar en vehículo robado. Un preso está más preocupado por su automóvil que por las personas hospitalizadas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre se enoja tanto afirmando que pagó una multa que lo tienen que atar a una silla. Un hombre hostil acusa a los oficiales de tocarlo inapropiadamente. Los oficiales ayudan a una madre e hijos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso combativo provoca el uso de gas pimienta. Una mujer borracha no coopera durante el proceso de ingreso. Un hombre quiere salir con el dedo parado cuando le toman la foto.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre enseña lo que no debe. Otro amenaza con dañarse y lo atan a una silla. En ratos no se le entiende a una mujer intoxicada. Un amputado es detenido por no pagar la entrada del metro.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer hostil es restringida. Aíslan a uno con reincidencia delictiva mal portándose. Otro dice lo que su familia y amigos piensan de él. Otro trató de robar café para sus amigos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Mandan a un hombre al tanque de borrachos. Una mujer ebria atacó a un niño. Un hombre no recuerda por qué lo arrestaron. Otro, tomó un automóvil ajeno prestado para no tomar drogas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Atan a un hombre ebrio a una silla. Otro que parece amable es arrestado por asalto. Un vagabundo es detenido por agresión. Un cliente frecuente amenazó con arma a los de seguridad en un bar.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre es detenido por manejar intoxicado. Una mujer borracha de buen humor es cooperativa. Un detenido derrama unas lágrimas mientras está aislado. En Las Vegas, un hombre está atado a una silla.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: En Sarasota, FL, un detenido rebelde es enviado a aislamiento dos veces. En el condado de Multnomah, un joven espera su liberación. En Portland, OR, un hombre es encarcelado por morder a su novia.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un delincuente honesto se entrega. Los oficiales arrestan a una mujer menor de edad que admite conducir bajo los efectos del alcohol. Una mujer es detenida después de lastimarse con unas tijeras.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre tenía la botella de cerveza abierta. Una mujer no sabe cómo es que tiene parafernalia. Un exconductor de autobús cuenta detalles tristes de su pasado. Los oficiales aconsejan a un ladrón.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los agentes detienen una pelea entre dos presos. Un hombre hostil interroga a las autoridades. Un hombre es arrestado por manejar intoxicado. Una mujer es detenida por agresión.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre ingobernable va al cuarto acolchado. Un hombre insulta mientras está bajo custodia. Un joven ebrio y destructivo va al tanque de borrachos. Una mujer intenta mentir sobre su detención.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un detenido acusa a los oficiales de involucración en Ruby-Ridge-1992. Un hombre ebrio se cae de su bicicleta, pero dice que lo atropellaron. Un preso trata de escapar mientras hay un disturbio.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre ebrio y agresivo pregunta por qué está detenido. Una pareja agredió a un cantinero. Un hombre acosó a los de seguridad en un cine. Detienen a un chofer por acumular varias infracciones.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Encarcelan a una mujer lasciva. Atan a un hombre a una silla por tratar de morder y arrancar sus dedos. Detienen a otro por posesión de drogas. Un vagabundo pasa por área prohibida y agredió.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Se aísla a un hombre intoxicado combativo. Un hombre usando vestido rojo les dice a los oficiales que es del FBI. Corrigen a dos jóvenes que roban un automóvil.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre insulta a base de raza y lo ponen en una celda. Un hombre solo solo en calzón es detenido por agresión a un oficial. Un anciano ebrio empieza a cantar durante el proceso de ingreso.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer bebió vino en caja y es violenta. Un hombre ebrio que fue detenido por orinar en frente de un restaurante quiere que se apuren para poder salir. Un ex-marino es detenido por abuso doméstico.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre pateó la ventana de la patrulla. La novia muerde al novio, y la relación acaba. Una mujer enojada apuñala al marido y él termina esposado. Otra se alegra de ir a la cárcel en su cumpleaños.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Primos llegan juntos a la cárcel, pero solo uno sale. Oficiales se esmeran contra un preso ingobernable. La meditación desnuda en un estacionamiento resulta en cárcel para un artista callejero.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un imitador de Batman golpeó a Chewbacca. Con brazo quebrado luche con oficiales. Es mejor pagar la multa que cumplir la condena. Una mujer da pretextos por estar vinculada con un señor mayor de edad.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un preso se enoja porque sospecha que la policía le perdió su dinero. Los oficiales batallan con un hombre ebrio. Una supuesta prostituta es apuñalada. Un trapecista ebrio se pasea en su ciclomotor.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Los oficiales tratan de lidiar con un borracho desastrado y combativo. Un hombre es encarcelado después de gastar todo lo que gano en el casino. Una mujer es engañada por su agente de fianzas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre quiere demostrar su fuerza al salir de prisión. Una mujer ebria se queja rabiosamente de todos. El guardadito de la pareja aurina los planes de boda. Un señor arrestado canta tristemente.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Seguimos a los oficiales del departamento de policía de LAS VEGAS METRÓPOLI que trata de mantener el orden durante las fiestas del Año Nuevo en la calle LAS VEGAS BLVD.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un vendedor de perfumes presume su "hechizo mágico”. Un hombre hace sangrar a su vecino. Una droga ilegal afecta el rostro de un hombre. Open Booking se presta como plataforma para una cantante.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre en calzón es detenido. Un papá es arrestado por manejar intoxicado cuando va por la pizza. Otro niega saber sobre las drogas en su bolsillo. Lo que pasa en Las Vegas, se queda en Las Vegas.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: El tequila tiene la culpa de que el hombre esté detenido. Una mujer trata de vender drogas por el internet. Un hombre que manejaba intoxicado piensa que está detenido por manejar muy lento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un sospechoso atado a una silla se porta de mal a peor. Un preso con cubreboca-antiescupir pide suplementos. A un preso le gusta la oficial. Un vagabundo quería lo suyo de la casa de su ex-esposa.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: No prender un porro cerca del crimen es la lección. Un oficial aconseja a una pareja joven drogadicta. Se le acaba la suerte a una prostituta con tutú. Los oficiales recogen a un niño por la 93ª vez.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer pelea con otra porque la ve fijamente. Arrestan a alguien porque al pelear quebró el vidrio de un hotel. Un cantante cree que los de música-rap lo rescatarán. Una mujer esposada coquetea.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Hombre cree ser un extraterrestre arrestado injustamente. Estudiante de derecho no entiende por qué fue arrestado. Mujer se tragó las pastillas de su amiga. Esposo termina moreteado y ensangrentado.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: La noche que Mayweather y Pacquiao pelean una mujer golpea al de seguridad. Un hombre que afirma haber servido en el ejército reta y amenaza. Un aficionado de "Pac-man" discute con su esposa.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Aíslan a un preso que tomó mucha cafeína. Un hombre arrestado por manejar tomado dice que le robaron. Un peatón cruzó la calle ilegalmente y según alguien lo golpeó. Un preso le da un puñetazo a otro.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: 45 veces detenida, pero tiene consejos para un drogadicto. Un juego de pies resulta en cárcel para dos hermanos australianos. Un guardia borracho de un club nocturno destruye su escúter.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer ebria aprende que portarse bien vale la pena. Una prostituta experta le ruega a una jovencita que se salga del “juego”. Una mujer enojada rompe el parabrisas de su novio infiel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Vagabundo golpea a alguien por un comentario racista. Hombre asalta con ladrillo a otro. Joven llora y afirma que fue arrestado falsamente. Luchador termina en el hospital y el cantinero en la cárcel.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Tres jovencitas fueron arrestadas por posesión de drogas en un festival de música. Hay drogas en una persona durante el ingreso. Un hombre mayor, en el festival de música, fue detenido por posesión.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una conductora con un bebé en el asiento trasero envía mensajes de texto, bebe y conduce. Tras ser detenido por robar en una tienda, un joven se da cuenta de las consecuencias de su delito.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado se enoja porque dejó comida en la parrilla; un hombre borracho coquetea con el personal de la cárcel; un recluso vende hojas de árbol como marihuana a un oficial encubierto.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un excéntrico habitual vuelve a la cárcel. Un hombre que huye de México detalla los horrores de los que escapó. Una mujer joven describe su lucrativa temporada como bailarina exótica

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer que se hace llamar la luz del sol tiene un carácter severa. Un hombre prefiere la cárcel a un centro de reinserción social. Un delincuente profesional no muestra ningún arrepentimiento.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un recluso afirma ser víctima de una estafa en internet que condujo a su arresto. Los agentes tratan con indulgencia a un recluso alborotador que atraviesa una crisis espiritual.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Dos hermanas se embarcan en una pequeña ola de delitos, son detenidas y descubren que nadie las sacará de la cárcel. Una discusión doméstica lleva a un marido a la cárcel por forzar su propio coche.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer agitada quiere tomar las decisiones. Un hombre borracho afirma que conoce la ley y un anciano es detenido por violencia doméstica.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Una mujer va a la cárcel tras decirle a la policía que se asustó por una máscara de mono. Un hombre ebrio se enamora de una agente. Un agente encuentra contrabando en un paquete de cigarrillos.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Durante un turno, los agentes se enfrentan con un recluso que se niega a cambiar de celda, y lidian con los caprichos de un hombre que exige servicio de habitaciones y una celda mejor.

programme.title: Jail en Español
programme.desc: Un padre comete un robo desesperado para llegar a fin de mes. Un chantaje se vuelve mortal cuando los agentes descubren un contrabando alarmante. Una reclusa se hace la inocente.

programme.desc: Un hombre arrestado por violencia doméstica amenaza con encarcelar a todos los agentes. Los reclusos de servicio de cocina se pelean por un paño de cocina. Una mujer es arrestada por allanamiento.

programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Sarah Graham’s Food Safari
programme.desc: Sarah Graham hosts dinner underneath a giant fig tree, one of her favourite spots in Antelope Park. Underneath the stars, guests enjoy venison skewers with red onion, roasted butternut and whipped feta, rosemary roosterkoek, and much more.

programme.title: Wine, Dine and Stein
programme.desc: Chef Jack Stein travels with his family to find the ultimate pairings with wine and food.

programme.title: A Taste of Italy with Nisha Katona
programme.desc: Chef and restaurateur Nisha Katona goes on a culinary journey to discover Italy's hidden foodie gems, learning the regional secrets that influence their dishes

programme.title: American Travelers
programme.desc: Dave and Kari explore Rome and Pompeii, discovering ancient landmarks, Italian culture and the legacy of Mount Vesuvius.

programme.title: World Tour
programme.desc: In the thrilling travel show “World Tour,” viewers embark on captivating adventures to the most exotic corners of the planet. From the charming streets of Paris to the breathtaking landscapes of New Zealand, each episode offers new amazing places, cultures, and traditions. With inspiring stories from locals and unexpected discoveries, “World Tour” immerses viewers in the exciting world of travel and adventure.

programme.title: Road Trip Masters
programme.desc: Nick and Brian cruise up to a place known for its alluring natural rock ledges and waterfalls. They head to Trout Town USA to try their hand at fly fishing. Then road trip back in time to the historical site of the legendary Woodstock music festival.

programme.title: New Zealand From Above
programme.desc: An aerial journey over New Zealand from the deep south of the South Island to the northern tip of the North Island. We discover the landscapes and meet New Zealanders who talk about their work, interests, and culture.

programme.title: Going Beyond
programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode, Sandra McLemore invites you to experience Austria like never before—through its royal palaces, charming villages, and centuries-old traditions. Wander through Schönbrunn Palace after hours, uncovering secret passageways, regal ballrooms, and stories of Empress Sisi. Then, watch a master pastry chef craft the perfect apple strudel—Vienna’s most iconic dessert. The journey continues to Dürnstein, a fairytale village in the Wachau Valley, where apricot orchards, wine, and UNESCO charm steal the spotlight. And in Hallstatt, go underground for an epic adventure through the world’s oldest working salt mine—slides, miner’s gear, and all. Along the way, Sandra shares must-know travel tips for making the most of your Austrian escape. From imperial elegance to alpine thrills, this episode blends history, culture, and flavor into one unforgettable journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the premiere of It's A Beautiful World, Jeff Fuchs joins a team of doctors as they navigate the vast waterways of the Amazon River to deliver vital healthcare to remote Indigenous communities. Set in the tri-border region between Colombia, Brazil, and Peru, this episode offers a powerful look at medicine, resilience, and human connection in one of the most isolated places on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff ventures deep into the Amazon rainforest to explore a secluded eco-lodge committed to sustainable living. He visits a monkey sanctuary working to rehabilitate rescued wildlife and ends the day by joining locals in a spirited community soccer tournament—celebrating the role of sport, conservation, and joy in jungle life.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Two years after his first Amazon expedition, Jeff Fuchs is invited back by his friend Juan Alan Muñoz for an extraordinary journey into one of the most remote and untouched parts of the rainforest. After arriving by cargo plane in the outpost of La Chorrera, Jeff boards Juan’s newly outfitted hospital boat—but before the journey can begin, he is summoned to meet the regional Chief of the Igara Paraná. In a powerful exchange of trust and tradition, Jeff offers gifts of maple syrup and receives the Chief’s blessing to travel the sacred waterways.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: With the Chief’s blessing—and a gesture of goodwill in the form of Canadian maple syrup—Jeff is invited to spend a day immersed in the region’s haunting past. Guided by the Chief, he visits rubber trees still standing as silent witnesses to the atrocities of the 1920s Amazon rubber boom, where the Chief’s own grandparents were slaughtered. The journey leads to the ruins of the Arana Brothers’ former headquarters, a chilling site of colonial exploitation, brutality, and genocide. In this moving episode, history, memory, and reconciliation converge deep in the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Before departing La Chorrera, Jeff takes time to explore Juan Alan Muñoz’s remarkable floating hospital—a lifeline for remote Amazonian communities. Onboard, Jeff witnesses eye surgeries, dental procedures, and vital health and nutrition services being delivered to those with no other access to medical care. As the boat prepares for its 400-mile journey, this episode offers an inspiring look at grassroots healthcare in one of the most inaccessible regions on Earth.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As the floating hospital leaves La Chorrera, Jeff arrives in the village of Providencia—home to the Bora people, whose culture is deeply tied to the sacred triad of coca, tobacco, and cassava. Unexpectedly, Jeff stumbles upon a rare and powerful event: a regional summit where Indigenous chiefs from across the Amazon have gathered to discuss peace, territory, and cultural preservation—an event many call the “G7 of the Amazon.” Following tradition, Jeff must await an invitation to meet the local chief. While respectfully waiting, he spends a day with a local fisherman, navigating the winding rivers and gaining insight into traditional fishing practices passed down through generations.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Throughout the journey, one sacred element has remained constant—Mambe, a traditional preparation of coca leaf that lies at the heart of Indigenous Amazonian life. In this episode, Jeff meets “Happy,” a spirited local who guides him through the complete Mambe-making process, from leaf to ritual. Through the voices of elders and community members, the episode explores the cultural, spiritual, and communal importance of Mambe—revealing its role not just as a sacred tradition, but as a living symbol of identity, respect, and connection to the land.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: As Jeff’s journey along the Igara Paraná draws to a close, the hospital boat enters the Putumayo River—edging ever closer to the self-isolated Pupuna tribe. The first stop along this new stretch is Puerto Arica, a lively river town hosting an international soccer tournament that brings together traders, travelers, and communities from across the Amazon. Amid the weekend of celebration, Jeff is invited on a night-time caiman hunt beneath a moonlit sky, and joins a local tradesman for an early morning fishing trip followed by a rustic riverside breakfast. It’s a brief but colorful pause before the journey continues deeper into isolation.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: While anchored for an overnight stay along the Putumayo River, Jeff and the crew are approached by a group of Israelites—members of a little-known, non-Indigenous community that has settled deep in the Amazon to prepare for a prophesied seven-year drought. What begins as a surreal encounter takes an unexpected turn when the group requests medical help for the ailing grandson of their community leader. This urgent plea grants Jeff and the team unprecedented access to a secretive world rarely seen by outsiders—revealing a unique blend of spiritual belief, isolation, and survivalist purpose hidden deep within the jungle.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: After weeks navigating remote rivers, dense jungle, and unexpected encounters, Jeff and the floating hospital team finally reach their most distant and mysterious destination: the territory of the self-isolated Pupuna. What follows is a delicate and respectful moment of contact, made possible only through trust built over years and the careful guidance of local leaders. With no cameras allowed beyond a certain point, Jeff experiences a rare glimpse into a community untouched by modern influence—where ancient ways of life endure in harmony with the forest. It is a quiet, humbling encounter that marks the emotional peak of the Amazon journey.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: In the season finale of It’s a Beautiful World, Jeff looks back on the unforgettable meals and spontaneous encounters and places that shaped his journey through the Amazon. This episode captures the emotional heart of the expedition.

programme.title: It's a Beautiful World
programme.desc: Jeff is finally summoned to the Maloka—the ceremonial longhouse—by the Chief of the Bora people. In a moment of deep cultural significance, the Chief offers his blessing and invites Jeff to witness a traditional gathering of the entire village and visiting Amazonian leaders. As sacred dances unfold in rhythmic celebration, the air is filled with the earthy scent of Mambe being prepared—coca leaves ground and mixed in an ancestral ritual that binds community, history, and spirit. It's a rare and intimate glimpse into the heart of Indigenous ceremony in the Amazon.

programme.title: Authentic Escapes
programme.desc: In this episode of Authentic Escapes, Sandra McLemore takes families on a journey where history and adventure come together in unforgettable ways. From navigating the hedge maze at Vienna’s Schönbrunn Palace—once a playground for royalty—to wandering the lavish halls of Cairo’s Abdeen Palace, this trip is anything but ordinary. In Aswan, families pause for an elegant high tea at the Old Cataract Hotel, the very place where Agatha Christie wrote Death on the Nile. It’s a moment of calm and connection, with sweeping Nile views and Egyptian charm. The journey wraps in Prague, where a vintage Alfa Romeo transforms a sightseeing tour into a glamorous ride through history. More than just sightseeing, Family Travel celebrates curiosity, culture, and time spent together. Whether you're sipping tea or solving a maze, these experiences spark conversations—and memories—that last long after the trip is over.

programme.desc: Going Beyond is wanderlust-filled hitchhiker Mariia Khandus’s new travel project. She’s journeyed around the world. Everybody knows that Thailand, Vietnam, and Indonesia are great places to relax with wonderful beaches and delicious fruits! But what do you know about the local people? The expats? About the real lives of those living in these exotic countries? In our trip, we will discover it all, together! We visit the non-touristy places and show you the real Indochina! This is a set of stories of different people, through the prism of whom we show life in a country. It is a collection of diverse achievements, experiences and emotions. We are looking for the most interesting stories for you to keep expanding your own consciousness. Unbelievable panoramic views, interesting people, exciting stories and adventures – you’ll see all of this in our travel show, Going Beyond!

programme.title: Para Verte Mejor
programme.desc: La muerte imprevista de Diego sembró un dolor durísimo en Daniela, pero también dejó a la luz que las sospechas de su deceso recayeran sobre Pedro, quien continúa moviendo las fichas en las vidas de todos los vecinos del condominio. Tanto es así, que luego de que la autopsia determinara “muerte natural”, intenta convencer a Daniela para que no venda el apartamento. Ella no podrá afrontar el costo mensual por el crédito bancario que con su marido habían sacado para comprarlo, y Pedro le ofrece un préstamo. Con esto, y ante la inminente seguridad de que tampoco podrá pagárselo, querrá quedarse con el apartamento.

programme.title: Guerra de Mujeres
programme.desc: Todo el mundo comienza a preguntar y Freddy es el que le dice a todos que esa pareja está empatada. Briggite está que se muere y comienza a preguntar que como es eso de que Yubileisy está empatada con su Whisky. Bienvenida sigue diciéndoles cosas a Yubiri y a Wilker. Ellos están pensando en ellos y Briggite totalmente fuera de lugar. Freddy y Solymar están afuera de la casa de Bienvenida hablando de lo mismo. Freddy le dice que es su héroe. Todos se van y se queda Yubiri con Briggite.

programme.title: El Árbol de Gabriel
programme.desc: Julieta se entera que no es hija de Ana Belén, por unos registros del hospital donde nació. Efraín y Ana Belén tratan de calmarla, pero no lo logran. Julieta se decide a irse de la casa, y Seis nueve le ofrece quedarse con Dilenis. Al día siguiente, Julieta se encuentra con Patricia, una monja que había ido a hacer un informe a ese barrio, y dos muchachos aparecen para acosarlas. Efraín habla con Valentina, para contarle lo sucedido, y ella le asegura que no fue quien le confesó eso a Julieta, cuando justo llega Ana Belén para hablar con Valentina. Nayarí decide contarle a Deibis que su tío es Gabriel León, pero a Deibis sólo le cae mal la noticia, ya que se había cruzado una vez con él, y no lo trató bien.

programme.title: Toda Mujer
programme.desc: Benjamín intenta huir del país con Hortensia y Glorita, pero es arrestado en el aeropuerto por las autoridades y Ricardo. Katiuska queda al frente del emporio Tarifa. Romina persuade a María del Pilar de fingir su embarazo para casarse con Marcelo. Amparo defiende la inocencia de Benjamín, mientras Ricardo recrimina a Manuela por no avisarle sobre Glorita. La tensión aumenta tras la captura de Benjamín, quien niega su verdadera identidad ante la policía.

programme.title: Episodio 98
programme.desc: Eustoquio roba documentos clave del despacho de Rivero para vengarse de Erasto. Alejandro nota a Leticia extraña y vuelve con la policía. Carlos asombra a Alejandro con conocimientos de amor sin unión física. Rosa confiesa a Carmen Rosa que se casó con Junior y ella se horroriza al saber que es su hermano. Consuelo enfrenta a Erasto reprochándole haber regalado una hacienda a Carmen Rosa. Erasto se horroriza al saber que Rosa se casó con Junior. Leticia es secuestrada por dos delincuentes de su tienda.

programme.title: Sacrificio de Mujer
programme.desc: Luís Francisco habla con Augusto, y le confiesa que todavía sigue enamorado de su esposa. Augusto, enfurecido al saber esto le dice que no lo quiere volver a ver. Luego, Luís Francisco habla con su madre, y ella le propone que tome lo que le pertenece de los Talamonti, y lo presiona por la deuda que tiene con un banco Italiano, pero él solamente quiere recuperar a Clemencia. De todos modos, Amada piensa encargarse de que los acreedores del banco Italiano le vayan a cobrar la deuda.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos logra que Junior reaccione tras el desmayo. Adolfo y Consuelo revelan a Rosa que su matrimonio debe anularse porque Junior es su hermano; ella confiesa que el hijo es de Alejandro. Blanca enfrenta a Arminda por haberle ocultado el paradero de Rosa toda la vida. Junior reclama a Marisela haberle ocultado la gravedad de su enfermedad. Erasto irrumpe en su casa al ver a Blanca y la amenaza, pero ella le anuncia que peleará por sus tierras. Rosa jura que siempre considerará a Carmen Rosa como su única madre y nunca dejará a Junior solo.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos consuela a Junior por su enfermedad y propone medicina alternativa para curarlo, que sus padres aceptan. Marisela ofrece a Alejandro mudarse a casa con Rosalía durante los últimos momentos de Junior. Rosa, dudando de todo, visita a Erasto buscando la verdad sobre su secuestro. Eustoquio amenaza a Erasto con denunciarlo. Blanca le pide a Alejandro recuperar sus tierras y averiguar la muerte de Benedicto. Rosa cae en la trampa de Erasto, quien le da su versión manipulada culpando a Blanca, pero ella le aclara que nunca olvidará que mató a su hermano Carlos.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Carlos explica a Junior que la cura es imposible y debe aceptar su realidad. Rosalía traiciona a Alejandro informándole a Erasto sobre sus planes para recuperar las tierras de Blanca. Marisela exige a Rosa callar la verdad ante Junior. Rivero hace desaparecer documentos por orden de Erasto. Junior pide a Rosa el divorcio para liberarla, pero ella se niega. Alejandro descubre que Rosa espera un hijo suyo y le pregunta qué hará. Blanca y Consuelo acosan a Carmen Rosa con preguntas en el hospital; Rosa irrumpe y las expulsa furiosamente.

programme.title: Pecado de Amor
programme.desc: Rosa expulsa furiosamente a Consuelo y Blanca del hospital. Carmen Rosa cuenta a Rosa que aceptó la ayuda de Erasto por desesperación. José Luis enfrenta a Erasto en la fiesta del gimnasio y es expulsado por seguridad. Carlos propone a Marisela ayudarla con su alcoholismo. Vilma orquesta el secuestro de Leticia mediante delincuentes contratados. Alejandro le confiesa a José Luis que se mudará a casa de los Alamo para estar cerca de Rosa. Natalia pacta con criminales para hacerle daño a alguien, complicando aún más la red de intrigas.
